about.title: A modern clinic, calm care
about.lead: T&Co Dental is a dental clinic in Plovdiv built around one idea: every patient deserves an accurate diagnosis, a clear explanation and quality treatment, and should never be left without help when they're in pain.
about.story1: Every treatment starts with a conversation and an accurate diagnosis. We have an X-ray unit in the clinic, so images are taken during your examination, and at your very first visit you know what's going on and what your options are.
about.story2: We work with a rubber dam because a clean, dry field makes treatment longer-lasting and safer. We explain each step and the cost upfront, and make decisions together with you.
about.story3: During regular hours we work with the NHIF. And because toothache doesn't keep office hours, we're also a 24/7 emergency dental clinic: a dentist on duty answers at any time.

values.clarityText: We explain the diagnosis, options and cost before we begin.
values.precisionText: On-site X-rays, a rubber dam and attention to detail in every procedure.
values.calmText: We never rush, especially with children and anxious patients.
values.availabilityText: Round-the-clock emergency care and online booking in a minute.
